## Thesis
The "Vault Manager Basket" is currently focused on tracking and managing futures related to the S&P 500 index, specifically the E-Mini and Micro E-Mini S&P 500 futures. This strategy aims to provide diversified exposure to the US equity market, leveraging the liquidity and volatility of these futures to optimize returns.
